title: PhysxVehicleAutoGearBoxAPI
summary: Automatic gear box of a standard vehicle drive: the up and down shift ratios. The walkers parse every prim that lists it. A standard drive uses the prim its physxVehicleDriveStandard:autoGearBox relationship targets (exactly one target), or the drive prim itself when it lists this API.
notes: Its columns are not described yet.
